Andre —

Thanks for the redlines. I’ve reviewed and added targeted edits; high level summary below and redlined DPA attached.

Summary of open items:
1) Cross-border transfers: Redwood can execute SCCs and will include a supplemental transfer mechanism clause. We do not perform transfers to countries not covered by SCCs.
2) KMS / customer-managed keys: GlobaFin’s ask for customer-controlled HSM/KMS is not supported in our hosted offering. We can offer a managed CMK model with strict access controls and audit logs, or discuss a Private deployment for full CMK control (longer lead time). If GlobaFin requires an exception to accept managed CMK, we need an explicit risk exception and CISO sign-off.
3) Subprocessors: We confirm the list attached; we can provide SOC2 and an attestation letter. Any critical vendor flagged by GlobaFin will require a short risk questionnaire.
4) Indemnity / liability caps: I proposed limited language to align with prior enterprise deals — see Section 7 redline.

Next steps we propose:
- Andre/procurement to confirm whether GlobaFin can accept managed CMK + attestation or needs full customer-controlled KMS.
- If GlobaFin requires an exception, Redwood will seek risk sign-off from Security (approx 48–72h) — we will expedite.
- We will prepare a DocuSign envelope for signature once parties agree to the KMS/transfer approach.

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_3.1_redlines.pdf (pdf)
